metadata.name: Cascadia Standard Parts Library demo components
metadata.note: Parts seed unreleased into the Standard Parts Library; they belong to no product structure.

parts.name: Battery, 24 V 75 Ah LiFePO4, Built-in BMS
parts.description: 25.6 V nominal / 75 Ah (1920 Wh) lithium iron phosphate battery with integrated 100 A BMS and M8 terminals, 330 x 180 x 220 mm, ~19.5 kg. Library candidate for extended-range applications; not yet released to any design.

parts.name: Battery, 24 V 20 Ah LiFePO4, Built-in BMS
parts.description: 25.6 V nominal / 20 Ah (512 Wh) lithium iron phosphate battery with integrated 30 A BMS and M8 terminals, 181 x 77 x 167 mm, ~5.0 kg. Library candidate for light or auxiliary loads; not yet released to any design.
